description: This file defines the `Country` class within the Opencart e-commerce framework, specifically in the localisation model. It provides methods to retrieve country data from the database, such as fetching by country ID, ISO codes, and retrieving all countries with caching support.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: Model class for country-related database operations within the Opencart localisation module.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Retrieves a country's details from the database based on the provided country ID.

methods.name: getCountryByIsoCode2
methods.description: Fetches country details using the ISO 2-letter country code.

methods.name: getCountryByIsoCode3
methods.description: Fetches country details using the ISO 3-letter country code.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Retrieves all active countries with descriptions, utilizing caching for performance.
